verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own materials say it auto-joins meetings to record, transcribe and summarize. They also promise detailed notes, action items and customized summaries instantly after every meeting, which covers the core of the story: an automatic post-meeting summary with next steps. Every supporting item is a short marketing or docs claim, so the structure and shareability of the output are not shown. missing for 10: explicit capture of decisions/key points as structured sections, evidence that summaries are shareable without editing, independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.
